action: On the Calendar View, choose 'Week View' in the view selector.
reset: Seeded user signed in, /setup synced, Calendar View open. Before: if the view is already Week, choose Day View first.
expectedStateChange: Seven day column headers are rendered and the toolbar title becomes a week range (dd/mm/yyyy – dd/mm/yyyy).

action: On the Calendar View, choose 'Month View' in the view selector.
reset: Calendar View open. Before: if the view is already Month, choose Week View first.
expectedStateChange: The month day grid (.fc-daygrid-body) is rendered and the toolbar title is a full-month range.

action: On the Calendar View, choose 'List View' in the view selector.
reset: Calendar View open. Before: if the view is already List, choose Day View first.
expectedStateChange: The list layout (.fc-list) is rendered and the selector shows List View.

action: On the Calendar View, choose 'Day View' in the view selector.
reset: Calendar View open. Before: if the view is already Day, choose Week View first.
expectedStateChange: Exactly one day column header is rendered, with a time grid (.fc-timegrid), and the selector shows Day View.

action: On the Calendar View, click the 'Next' navigation button in the toolbar.
reset: Calendar View open at the current date. The previous step's date is carried into the next case; C06 undoes this.
expectedStateChange: The toolbar title text changes to the following period.

action: On the Calendar View, click the 'Previous' navigation button in the toolbar.
reset: Calendar View open, usually one period after the current one from C05. C06 returns the date to the earlier period.
expectedStateChange: The toolbar title text changes to the preceding period.

action: On the Calendar View, click the 'Show Tasks' switch label.
reset: Calendar View open with Show Tasks on (default). C08 switches it back.
expectedStateChange: The #show_tasks_switch checkbox changes its checked state.

action: On the Calendar View, click the 'Show Tasks' switch label again.
reset: Show Tasks has been toggled once by C07; this case toggles it back.
expectedStateChange: The #show_tasks_switch checkbox changes its checked state back.

action: On the Calendar View, click 'Add from Templates'.
reset: Calendar View open, no dialog showing. Before: if a dialog is open, press Escape.
expectedStateChange: A modal dialog titled 'Add from Templates' opens and lists the seeded 'Weekly review' template.

action: With the 'Add from Templates' dialog open, press Escape.
reset: Before: if no dialog is open, click 'Add from Templates' first. The dialog is then closed.
expectedStateChange: The modal dialog is removed from the page (no .modal.show element remains).

action: On the Settings page, change 'Starting Day of the Week for Calendar View' to a different day and press the first Save.
reset: Reached from the settings menu. Before: navigate to Settings. The target day is Sunday unless it is already Sunday, in which case Monday.
expectedStateChange: The day selector shows the new value and a toast reads 'Updated successfully!'.

action: On the Settings page, change the Date Format to the other of 'YYYY-MM-DD' and 'DD/MM/YYYY' and press the date/time Save.
reset: Settings page open with the saved date format shown. Before: navigate to Settings if needed and wait until the saved format is shown.
expectedStateChange: The 'Sample Output for Date and Time' text changes to the new date format and a 'Date Format: Updated successfully!' toast appears.

action: On the Settings page, change the Time Format to the other of 'HH:mm' and 'hh:mm A' and press the date/time Save.
reset: Settings page open. Before: navigate to Settings if needed.
expectedStateChange: The 'Sample Output for Date and Time' text changes its time part (AM/PM suffix added or removed) and a 'Time Format: Updated successfully!' toast appears.

action: On the Settings page, click the 'Nuke Local Data on Logout?' checkbox.
reset: Settings page open. The checkbox is toggled once by this case; the next run starts from the seeded (unchecked) state.
expectedStateChange: The #default-nukedexie_checkbox checked state changes.

action: On the WebCAL Manager page, click 'Add'.
reset: Reached from the settings menu. Before: navigate to WebCAL Manager and close the add form if it is open.
expectedStateChange: The add form appears with a name field (maxlength 50), a link field (maxlength 1000) and an interval field; the Add button is replaced by the form.

action: With the WebCAL add form open, enter the name 'Holiday calendar' and the second local calendar link, the bench fixture at /bench/holiday-calendar.ics, then press Add.
reset: Before: open the add form if it is closed. The seeded local link is already subscribed, and the app rejects a second subscription to the same link, so the second fixture is used. The server fetches the link and stores its events; the seeded database is restored before every run.
expectedStateChange: A 'Done!' toast appears and the 'Holiday calendar' card is listed on the page.

action: On the WebCAL Manager page, press the sync icon on the 'Team calendar' card.
reset: Before: navigate to WebCAL Manager. The sync fetches the seeded local link again.
expectedStateChange: A 'Sync done!' toast appears.

action: On the WebCAL Manager page, press the delete icon on the 'Team calendar' card.
reset: Before: navigate to WebCAL Manager. The Team calendar subscription is removed for the rest of the run.
expectedStateChange: A 'Deleted successfully.' toast appears and the server's webcal list (GET /api/webcal/get) no longer contains 'Team calendar'.

action: On the Template Manager page, press the delete icon on the 'Weekly review' template.
reset: Before: navigate to Template Manager. The seeded template is removed for the rest of the run.
expectedStateChange: A 'Deleted successfully.' toast appears and the 'Weekly review' card is removed from the page.

action: On the Manage Filters page, click 'Add New Filter'.
reset: Reached from the settings menu. Before: navigate to Manage Filters and click Close if the form is already open.
expectedStateChange: The filter form appears, with the 'Enter filter name.' field visible and the Save button present.

action: On the Task View, click 'Gantt View'.
reset: Task View open with the list layout. Before: navigate to Task View and click 'Task View' if Gantt is already active.
expectedStateChange: The 'Gantt View' button becomes the active button (btn-secondary) and 'Task View' becomes btn-outline-secondary.

action: On the Task View, click 'Task View' to return to the list layout.
reset: Gantt layout active from C21. Before: click 'Gantt View' if the list layout is already active.
expectedStateChange: The 'Task View' button becomes the active button (btn-secondary) and 'Gantt View' becomes btn-outline-secondary.

action: On the Task View, expand or collapse the 'Filters' accordion.
reset: Task View list layout. The accordion is flipped once by this case.
expectedStateChange: The 'Filters' accordion button's aria-expanded attribute changes value.

action: Click the dark/light mode icon in the top navigation bar.
reset: Any page with the navigation bar; the theme is light at the start of the run.
expectedStateChange: The document's data-bs-theme attribute changes between 'light' and 'dark'.
